about: The 40 sites for the visual taste calibration (ChatGPT's Creative Direction Atlas). Picked for visual quality and interaction originality alone; the engineering-transfer rankings in top-tier.json were deliberately ignored. Groups: cinematic = visual art direction, interaction = original interaction, both = strong on each.
